relations.subject: George Thomas Tanselle
relations.evidence: He received a bachelor's degree from Yale University in 1955.

relations.subject: George Thomas Tanselle
relations.evidence: Tanselle attended graduate school at Northwestern University where he studied with Harrison Hayford among others.

relations.subject: George Thomas Tanselle
relations.evidence: He received his PhD in 1959 from the department of English where his dissertation was titled Faun at the Barricades: The Life and Work of Floyd Dell.

relations.subject: George Thomas Tanselle
relations.evidence: From 1960 through 1978 he taught at the University of Wisconsin.

relations.subject: George Thomas Tanselle
relations.evidence: After moving to New York City in 1978, he served as vice president of the John Simon Guggenheim Memorial Foundation until 2006.

relations.subject: George Thomas Tanselle

relations.subject: George Thomas Tanselle
